mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tt_trigger_binding (definition_id, binding_key, provider_key, schema_version, config_json, config_hash, binding_state, schedule_generation, next_fire_at, cursor_json, exhausted, revision, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{definitionId}, #{bindingKey}, #{providerKey}, #{schemaVersion}, #{configJson}, #{configHash}, #{bindingState}, #{scheduleGeneration}, #{nextFireAt}, #{cursorJson}, #{exhausted}, #{revision}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tt_trigger_binding WHERE trigger_binding_id = #{triggerBindingId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM tt_trigger_binding WHERE definition_id = #{definitionId} ORDER BY binding_key
mapper.update: UPDATE tt_trigger_binding SET next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, cursor_json = #{cursorJson}, exhausted = #{exhausted}, revision = #{newRevision}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE trigger_binding_id = #{triggerBindingId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE tt_trigger_binding SET config_json = #{configJson}, config_hash = #{configHash}, schedule_generation = #{scheduleGeneration}, next_fire_at = #{nextFireAt}, cursor_json = #{cursorJson}, exhausted = #{exhausted}, revision = #{newRevision}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE trigger_binding_id = #{triggerBindingId} AND revision = #{expectedRevision}
mapper.select: SELECT trigger_binding_id FROM tt_trigger_binding WHERE provider_key = #{providerKey} AND binding_state = 'ACTIVE' AND exhausted = 0 AND (next_fire_at IS NULL OR next_fire_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY next_fire_at ASC, trigger_binding_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
